budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Supply each polity's opposite-bank outpost twice before any outpost defense reaches zero; manage couriers, fuel, relay information and timed passage agreements.
task.natural_termination: Failure when any defense is zero after pressure. Otherwise success when every outpost has at least two deliveries. If these coincide, defense loss prevents success; both are natural completion, with natural causes taking priority over H.
task.interaction: One polity's offer changes another's legal council choices; acceptance creates temporary pass access and access to the grantor's powered beacon information. Supply investments compete with delivering and defending each polity's outpost.
task.observation_access: Partially observable. Every role sees Manhattan radius two around its courier and radius three around its own powered relays or relays owned by a polity currently granting it passage. Other roles' couriers, cargo and home stocks are masked outside revealed cells; owned home and owned beacon telemetry remain known. Public outposts/defenses, pass locations/owners, pending offers, accepted agreement timers and specified public events are broadcast. The world map declares map_visible and never public=true. Hidden map/objects are -1 in the flat observation with explicit visibility bits. Role renderers bind the same masks; hidden blocked-move events and unrevealed refuel events are not public event channels.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Public owner-to-guest offer matrix created this step.
Public owner-to-guest acceptance matrix this step.
Public outpost deliveries this step by owner.
Public frontier pressure reduced defenses this step.
Cumulative public outpost deliveries by owner.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
